title: 10th Sitting of third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/10/3/2026).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 4/3/2026 to 6/3/2026).
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Tax Administration Act (Law No. 3/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdhooh.
General Committee report, under Article 272(b) of the Majlis Standing Orders, on Thulhaadhoo MP Abdulhannaan Aboobakuru's proposal to amend Article 191 of the Standing Orders.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to approve old minutes, debate a Tax Administration Act amendment, and take a committee report on changing a Majlis standing order.
